deficit_feed.gain_ruling: D178 (2), corrected by flash addendum 12 item 2
deficit_feed.form: w_d = 1 + gain * (shortfall_d / target_d), floored at 1, PER DEVICE
deficit_feed.currency: on-time CLOUD answers only (D177, D178 (1)); device_on_time recorded, never added to the numerator

planner_time_limit._note: cf_instrument.over_budget is a WALL-CLOCK limit (D99 (3), D151 (5)), so this rate is a property of the host CPU as well as of the policy. The H100 host is about 2.2x slower than flash on the committed policy benchmark (D115 (1)), so a rate measured on flash is a LOWER BOUND for a live cell and must not be quoted for one. Proofs run with the limit OFF so a decision digest is a property of the arm; live cells run with it ON because it is a real cost

metrics_health.why: the /metrics scrape was switched off for this cell, so every engine-metric quantity in it is an absence and not an observation

source_agreement.note: sha256 of files ON DISK (did the tree move under the cell, not what bytecode executed). Case 1 runner_child_mismatch -> TornTree before running; case 2 moved_after_import -> WARNING, cell kept (an imported module is cached, the change did not execute); case 3 torn_lazy_import -> INVALID. Bounds: a file changed and changed back within a cell is invisible; runner-only files are outside case 1 and are covered by the runner's pre-flight refusal instead (disjoint halves, keep both); repo files only.
